other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala
Applicant must be a differently abled student with disability of 40% or more (Blind, Deaf, Orthopedically handicapped, or Mental Retardation)
Applicant must have secured at least 40% marks in the previous year’s examination
Applicant must be studying in schools, colleges, professional, postgraduate courses or technical training
Annual family income of the applicant must be below ₹36,000
benefits_summary: Monthly cash scholarships ranging from ₹300 to ₹1500 for day scholars and hostel students, plus a reader’s allowance, based on the level of study.
